UI_PS_Options_ToggleKey_tooltip: Ignites or extinguishes the photon sword in your hands.
UI_PS_Options_BatteryKey_tooltip: Loads your fullest battery into the held (or first) hilt, returning the old one. Ignored when R would reload a gun, sharpen a blade, or rotate something you're placing.
UI_PS_Options_CutKey_tooltip: Turns cutting on or off for your swings while holding an ignited photon sword: doors, windows, walls, objects, and vegetation, as far as the sandbox options allow. Off by default. X still racks guns when one is held.
UI_PS_Options_ExtinguishOnHolster_toolti: Automatically extinguish a blade when it goes back on the hotbar.
UI_PS_Options_BladeLight_tooltip: Ignited blades cast colored light. Only affects what you see.
UI_PS_Options_LightRadius_tooltip: How many tiles the blade light reaches.
UI_PS_Options_VanillaStance_tooltip: Hold an ignited photon sword with the game's own two-handed animations instead of the photon sword stance (rest, walks, ready stance, and its beckon). Applies to every player you see.
UI_PS_Options_BeckonChance_tooltip: Every 3 seconds standing aimed with a photon sword, the chance the off hand beckons. 0 turns the beckon off. You roll it for every player you see.
UI_PS_Options_HumVolume_tooltip: Volume of the hum from ignited blades, yours and other players'. 0 turns it off.
UI_PS_Options_HumTone_tooltip: Character of the idle hum. Smooth is a pure low tone, Gritty is buzzier with crackle.
UI_PS_Options_HumPitch_tooltip: Pitch of the idle hum. 100 is the default.
UI_PS_Options_SwingTone_tooltip: Character of your own blade's swing sound. Smooth is a clean whoosh, Gritty is buzzier with crackle.
UI_PS_Options_SwingPitch_tooltip: Pitch of your blade's swing sound, in steps of 10. 100 is the default.
UI_PS_Options_HitTone_tooltip: Character of the spark when your blade strikes something. Smooth is a soft sizzle, Gritty throws a heavy shower of sparks.
UI_PS_Options_HitPitch_tooltip: Pitch of your blade's hit spark, in steps of 10. 100 is the default.
UI_PS_Options_DeflectText_tooltip: Show Deflected, Blocked, or Absorbed over your character when your guard stops gunfire.
UI_PS_Options_DeflectSound_tooltip: Play the blade's hit spark when a guard stops gunfire.
UI_PS_Options_LowPower_tooltip: Show a warning when an ignited blade's power drops to this level. 0 turns it off.
